criteria.plan: deciding what to do or how to split the work
criteria.tool: calling a tool that does something
criteria.read: reading a result, a file or a page
criteria.check: checking work or a claim against a source
criteria.answer: writing the final answer to the person

questions.instructions: What kind of step is about to happen?
questions.purpose: Says what the next model call is for.
questions.retirement: Retire if the local rules match this answer's accuracy at the same cost, per the reader test in the paper's section 10 test 1.
questions.name: Kind of step

criteria: mechanical: copy a value, apply a known edit, repeat a pattern
routine: ordinary work that needs attention
deep: it needs real thought or a judgment call
questions.instructions: How much thought does this step need?
questions.purpose: Lets a mechanical step use a cheaper model than the dial would pick for the task.
questions.retirement: Retire if the local rules match this answer's accuracy at the same cost, per the reader test in the paper's section 10 test 1.
questions.name: Depth of the step

criteria.item: only the single item in hand

questions.instructions: How much of the conversation does this step need to see?
questions.purpose: Decides whether the step can be fed a brief instead of the whole thread.
questions.retirement: Retire if the local rules match this answer's accuracy at the same cost, per the reader test in the paper's section 10 test 1.
questions.name: Context the step needs

questions.instructions: After this step, how many more mechanical steps of the same kind will probably follow?
questions.purpose: Feeds the break-even rule for handing a running thread to another model.
questions.retirement: Retire if the local rules match this answer's accuracy at the same cost, per the reader test in the paper's section 10 test 1.
questions.name: Mechanical steps ahead

questions.instructions: Does this step change something outside the conversation, or state a fact that others will rely on?
questions.purpose: Sends work that commits or claims to a check by another model family.
questions.retirement: Retire if the local rules match this answer's accuracy at the same cost, per the reader test in the paper's section 10 test 1.
questions.name: Commits or claims
